entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A short, blue-skinned goblin sorcerer-student at Strixhaven who joins Prismari College; smart but impulsive.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Sanar studies.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college Sanar joins.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: The teaching assistant who guides Sanar's class to Harrier's Wood.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker who lures the students through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who flies her classmates across the Wanderwine River and returns with Eirdu.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A Strixhaven student kidnapped by an elven hunter and forced to pick dawnglow.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who uses probability magic and is injured by moonglow.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane the students are lured to, alternating between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A portal between planes that takes the students to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and back.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A moon-headed, winged, six-armed night elemental that the students accidentally wake, plunging Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Isilu's opposite, the sun-headed elemental, who returns with Abigale and embraces Isilu to restore balance.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin who meets the students, offers hospitality and directs them to Maralen.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The kithkin village Brigid brings the students to, plunged into Shadowmoor by Isilu.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The queen of the faeries who appears to be turning into Oona and enlists the students' help.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen into whom Maralen appears to be turning.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's palace.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Maralen's aide, sworn to kill her if she turns into Oona.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: An old companion of Maralen's found at the Stinkdrinker warren.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker enlisted by Liliana Vess to rescue the students.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: The students' professor, who enlists Ajani to rescue them.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The leader of the Lorwyn elves, who forced Kirol to pick dawnglow.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: Kirol's new ally who helps steal the vial and later joins Strixhaven's cross-planar program.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic that kidnapped Oracle Jadzi and emits reality-warping magic, finally stopped by the students' unity.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An Oracle kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic, who performs a ritual to calm it and disappears into wild magic.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who believes Jace's meddling disrupted the Archaics.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker blamed by Chandra for disrupting the Archaics.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The site where the Dawning Archaic appears and where the group falls into a chasm.

events.summary: Oko lures Sanar, Abigale, Kirol and Tamira through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor while they collect flowers at Harrier's Wood.
events.quote: the faerie planeswalker Oko appeared and lured Sanar

events.summary: The students accidentally wake Isilu in a chamber beyond carvings, and darkness floods the world.
Brigid Baeli meets the students and offers them hospitality as the night erases their Omenpath.
Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, plunging it into Shadowmoor, and the students flee toward Glen Elendra.
events.quote: Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Kirol is kidnapped by an elven hunter and Abigale falls into a tributary of the Wanderwine.
events.quote: Kirol was kidnapped by an elven hunter

events.summary: Tamira and Sanar find Maralen turning into Oona; Tamira makes Rhys miss his attack and Maralen enlists their help.
events.quote: Tamira used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window

events.summary: The group finds Ashling at the Stinkdrinker warren and sets out to track Isilu, but is halted by Brigid and the Shadowmoor kithkin.
events.quote: The four set out to track down Isilu

events.summary: Lorwyn elves attack Isilu, kithkin join the fight, and Maralen and Tamira are poisoned with moonglow.
events.quote: Maralen and Tamira were injured with the deadly poison moonglow

events.summary: Ajani arrives with Kirol, and Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal the dawnglow vial, saving Maralen and Tamira.
events.quote: snuck into the elven lines, stole the vial, and brought it back, saving Maralen and Tamira's lives

events.summary: Abigale returns with Eirdu, and the two gods embrace, restoring balance.
events.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

events.summary: The students return to Arcavios via Shandalar with Ajani, and Lluwen joins the cross-planar program.
events.quote: Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program
The following semester, Sanar joined Prismari College.

events.summary: Chandra confronts the group at Titan's Grave blaming Jace; the Dawning Archaic returns and everyone falls into a chasm.
events.quote: the students and planeswalkers fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it

events.summary: Tam casts Jadzi and herself into wild magic, and Lluwen finishes the ritual with his friends, stopping the Archaic.
events.quote: Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself

relations.quote: Sanar is a goblin sorcerer -student at Strixhaven University
Tamira and Sanar decided to continue on Brigid's directions to Glen Elendra

relations.note: Lured him and his classmates to another plane.
relations.quote: lured Sanar, along with his classmates Abigale , Kirol , and Tamira , through an Omenpath

relations.note: Opposite gods who embrace and restore balance.
relations.quote: Abigale returned, with Isilu's opposite Eirdu in tow
